NO_DISCREPANCY_FOUND.meaning: Source and IR appear semantically consistent

bs01RelativeBpValidation.printedText: This Spirit can't block Spirits with BP inferior to this Spirit's.
bs01RelativeBpValidation.engineMechanismEvaluated: engine/continuous.js canBlock() evaluates CANNOT_BLOCK unconditionally. No continuous relative BP comparison against attacker exists in engine.
bs01RelativeBpValidation.defectSeparation: Compiler defect: strips relative BP comparison. Engine limitation: cannotBlock modifier does not support dynamic comparison filters against attacker stack.
